name: Opening
title: 让听障人士，及时感知路上的线索
en: ENVIRONMENTAL AWARENESS FOR DEAF AND HARD-OF-HEARING PEOPLE

voice.zh: 小林是一位听障人士，正在独自出行。
voice.en: Xiaolin is deaf or hard of hearing and is travelling independently.

voice.zh: SoundBridge，把重要的环境声音，转化为腕上的提醒。
voice.en: SoundBridge turns important environmental sounds into cues on her wrist.

voice.zh: 这一次，我们跟随她走过一段日常道路。
voice.en: Follow her along an everyday journey.

name: Approach
title: 身后的车铃，抵达手腕
en: A BELL BEHIND HER. A CUE ON HER WRIST.

voice.zh: 骑行者从左后方接近，车铃响起。
voice.en: A cyclist approaches from behind on the left and rings a bell.

voice.zh: 四个麦克风接收声音，识别车铃后，发出三次短振。
voice.en: Four microphones capture the sound. Recognizing the bicycle bell triggers three short pulses.

voice.zh: 三次短振引起注意，小林抬腕查看类别和来向。
voice.en: Three short pulses get her attention. Xiaolin checks the sound class and direction on her wrist.

voice.zh: 她转头确认，靠边让行，等骑行者通过。
voice.en: She looks around, moves aside and lets the cyclist pass.

name: Array
title: 四路信号，共同判断来向

voice.zh: 手表上的四个麦克风，位于不同的位置。
voice.en: Four microphones sit at different positions on the watch.

voice.zh: 比较同一次声音到达的微小时差，可以估算声音的来向。
voice.en: Tiny differences in arrival time help estimate where the sound came from.

voice.zh: 骑行者从左后方经过左前方，空间位置与表盘角度同步变化。
voice.en: As the cyclist moves from rear left to front left, the source position and dial angle change together.

name: Crossing
title: 路口的鸣笛，提醒她留意车辆
en: NOTICE THE VEHICLE AT THE CROSSING.

voice.zh: 来到路口，一辆车从右前方驶来。
voice.en: At a crossing, a vehicle approaches from the front right.

voice.zh: 识别鸣笛后，两次长振提醒她，表盘显示类别和来向。
voice.en: Recognizing the horn triggers two long pulses. The dial shows the sound class and direction.

voice.zh: 收到振动后，她抬腕查看，在路缘内停步观察。
voice.en: Feeling the vibration, she checks her watch and stops before the curb.

name: Wait
title: 先观察，等车辆通过
en: LOOK FIRST. LET THE VEHICLE PASS.

voice.zh: 看清车辆的行进方向，她留在安全的位置等待。
voice.en: She checks the vehicle direction and waits in a safe position.

voice.zh: 等车辆通过，确认道路情况，再继续前行。
voice.en: After it passes, she checks the road and continues.

name: Bearing
title: 类别与方向，让提醒更清楚
en: KNOW THE SOUND. UNDERSTAND ITS DIRECTION.

voice.zh: 声音类别告诉她，发生了什么；来向提示帮助她决定往哪里看。
voice.en: The sound class explains what happened. Direction helps her decide where to look.

voice.zh: 表盘同时呈现角度、文字和指示标记，减少理解的负担。
voice.en: Angles, text and a pointer make the cue easier to understand.

voice.zh: 触觉引起注意，视觉补充信息，最后由她观察和判断。
voice.en: Touch gets her attention. Visual cues add context. She observes and decides.

name: Personalize
title: 在安全位置，调整适合自己的提醒
en: PERSONALIZE THE CUE IN A SAFE PLACE.

voice.zh: 在步道旁停稳后，小林调整手表的提醒方式。
voice.en: Stopped safely beside the path, Xiaolin adjusts her watch.

voice.zh: 振动强度和文字大小，按照她的感受来设置。
voice.en: She sets vibration strength and text size to suit her.

voice.zh: 让每一次提醒清楚而舒适，帮助她从容关注周围。
voice.en: Clear, comfortable cues help her stay aware of her surroundings.

name: Structure
title: 一份安全线索，来自内部协作
en: INSIDE EVERY CUE, COMPONENTS WORK TOGETHER.

voice.zh: 她继续行走时，我们看看手表内部如何协作。
voice.en: As she continues walking, we look inside the watch.

voice.zh: 麦克风收集信号，处理电路识别声音，显示模组和触觉马达传达提醒。
voice.en: Microphones capture signals. The board identifies sounds. The display and haptic actuator deliver the cue.

voice.zh: 部件平稳展开，再沿原位收回。技术的目的，是让重要线索及时被感知。
voice.en: The layers separate smoothly and return to place. Their purpose is to make important cues perceptible.

name: RearAlert
title: 再次接近，也能及时察觉

voice.zh: 另一位骑行者从右后方接近，手表再次识别车铃。
voice.en: Another cyclist approaches from behind on the right. The watch identifies the bell.

voice.zh: 短振与右后方提示出现，小林抬腕，转头观察。
voice.en: Short pulses and a rear-right cue appear. Xiaolin checks her wrist and looks around.

voice.zh: 她让出空间，保持对周围的警觉，等待对方通过。
voice.en: She makes space, stays aware of her surroundings and lets the rider pass.

name: Closing
title: 让听障人士，更从容地出行

voice.zh: 安全感，来自及时的线索，也来自自己的判断。
voice.en: Confidence comes from timely cues and her own judgment.

voice.zh: SoundBridge，为听障人士设计的环境感知手表。
voice.en: SoundBridge. An environmental awareness watch for deaf and hard-of-hearing people.
